messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, including its lighting effects on the person. Change only the environment and its lighting. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She begins standing in profile, then walks forward and to the right across the frame, turning her back to the camera as she stops at the edge of a raised platform.","camera":"The camera is at a low angle in a vertical frame, panning right to follow her as she walks.","clothing":"She wears a short, form-fitting one-piece dress with a busy multicolored pattern of pink, purple, yellow, orange, and black shapes, and brown flat shoes.","hair_color":"Her hair is light brown to dark blonde.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled back into a high ponytail with a small tuft sticking up at the crown, and a dark scrunchie or hair tie is visible at the nape.","identity":"A young woman with a slim build, light skin, and a youthful face is shown in profile and then from behind.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor concrete terrace beside a calm pool of water, with a stone wall, rusted metal railings and pipes, wooden posts in the water, and a clear blue sky."},"uncertain":["The exact style of the brown footwear is unclear, though they appear to be flat shoes or sandals."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a gray industrial rooftop with metal panels and a beige building to a sunny waterfront terrace with a stone retaining wall, rusted railings and pipes, rocks, calm water, wooden posts, and blue sky. The person's lighting became warmer and more directional, matching the new outdoor scene. Her pose, walking action, dress, hairstyle, and general camera tracking remain broadly similar.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original rooftop environment with the reference waterfront scene, including its lighting on the person, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, expression, action, and the existing camera framing and movement.
uncertain: Whether the camera framing and movement are exactly identical to the source, since the new background makes precise comparison difficult.
unexpected_changes: The person's hair appears lighter, more blonde, in the output than in the source, likely due to the new lighting but still a visible appearance change.
